title: Persistent Bluetooth pairing request with Bond BT Device on A15+ setting
symptom: When enabling the Preferences->Bond BT Device on A15+ (Pixel Phones Workaround) setting, persistent Bluetooth pairing requests appear on every Bluetooth attempt. Disabling the setting removes the requests but the workaround is unavailable. After accepting the pairing, the pump is unable to communicate with AAPS, showing READSTATUS KeepAlive. Status outdated on refresh.
cause: The persistent pairing request is normal and expected when using the Dash bond option in AAPS.
fix: Accept the pairing request, or if not needed, disable the Bond BT Device setting to stop the pairing requests.
settings_changed: Bond BT Device on A15+ (Pixel Phones Workaround) → enabled/disabled
evidence_quote: That's normal and expected. You need to accept the pairing request.
